Description: A vast cavern opens before you, its ceiling lost in darkness. Bioluminescent mushrooms of every color carpet the floor, and a crystalline spring bubbles at the center, its water glowing a soft, inviting blue.

Replies.FlText: The water tastes sweet, then wrong. The mushrooms around you turn toward you in unison, and the garden attacks.
Replies.SsText: The water is cold and impossibly clean. Warmth spreads through your body and your wounds knit closed.
You carefully pick the safest-looking caps and bundle them away. Some may even be edible.

Replies.ReplyText: Purify the water with healing magic.
Replies.FlText: The spores fight back, lashing out with stinging tendrils before you can finish the ritual.
Replies.SsText: Your magic sweeps the spring clean of spores. The pure water restores the whole party.

Replies.ReplyText: Follow the glowing thread to its source.
Replies.SsText: The thread ends in a soft, lichen-furred creature. It leans against your leg as if it had always been there.
Replies.FlText: You lose the thread in the dark and bruise yourself on the roots.
